caption: Total cost over the first 12 months: buying starts with a ₹2,40,00,000 bill and adds ₹3,00,000 every month, while renting pays only for servers that are switched on. The rented line ends at ₹1,64,16,000 against ₹2,76,00,000 for buying, a saving of ₹1,11,84,000.

spec.aria: Line chart of total cost across 12 months: buying 300 servers starts at ₹2,40,00,000 and climbs to ₹2,76,00,000, while renting by the hour starts at zero and climbs to ₹1,64,16,000, staying below the bought line for the whole year.
